title: Bind SQL parameters
text: User input in SQL must use bound parameters. String interpolation is prohibited.

title: Keep secrets out of logs
text: Never log access tokens, passwords, signing keys, or session cookies, even at debug level.

title: Authorize each protected operation
text: Protected endpoints must verify permission for the requested resource. Authentication alone is insufficient.

title: Validate uploaded files
text: File uploads must enforce both a size limit and an allowed content type before storage.

title: Compare signatures safely
text: Authentication signatures must use a constant-time comparison function.

title: Encrypt outbound traffic
text: External service requests must use HTTPS. Plain HTTP is prohibited, including internal tooling sent off premises.

title: Redact personal data
text: Production logs must not contain raw email addresses, street addresses, or payment details.

title: Scope shared caches
text: Cache keys for customer data must include both tenant ID and resource ID. A resource ID alone is not globally unique.

title: Deprecate before dropping columns
text: Removing a persisted column requires an earlier released migration that stops reading and writing it. A same-release removal is prohibited.

title: Keep money in integer units
text: Store and calculate monetary values as integer minor units, never binary floating-point currency values.

title: Obtain approval for source export
text: Sending proprietary source code or raw diffs to an external provider requires an explicitly documented data-export authorization.

title: Bound personal-data retention
text: New personal-data stores must declare a retention period no longer than 30 days and a deletion mechanism.

title: Set outbound timeouts
text: Every outbound HTTP call must set an explicit timeout of no more than 5 seconds. Library defaults do not satisfy this rule.

title: Bound retry attempts
text: An operation may make at most 3 total attempts, including its first attempt. Retries require a finite bound.

title: Report write failures honestly
text: Failed writes must surface an error. Returning a success response after a write exception is prohibited.

title: Make payment retries idempotent
text: Payment creation calls must supply a stable idempotency key reused across every retry of that payment.

title: Handle empty collections
text: New operations over collections must handle the empty case before indexing or dividing by the collection length.

title: Bound database page sizes
text: Public list endpoints must cap requested page size at 100 records and reject negative sizes.

title: Test changed behavior
text: A behavior-changing PR must provide passing tests for the changed behavior in its review packet.

title: Cover authorization denial
text: New authorization logic requires at least one denied-access test, not only the permitted case.

title: Keep tests deterministic
text: Tests must not depend on live external services, wall-clock timing, or unseeded randomness.

title: Do not silently skip failures
text: A test may only be skipped when the review packet links a tracking issue and names an expiry date.

title: Assert outcomes
text: A regression test must assert the returned result or persisted effect; merely calling the function is insufficient.

title: Include boundary cases
text: New numeric limits must include tests at the accepted limit and immediately outside it.

title: Include rollback for releases
text: A production behavior change must include a concrete rollback procedure in its review packet.

title: Keep required health checks
text: Removing or bypassing a deployment health check requires an approved incident exception, included in the packet.

title: Pin third-party dependencies
text: New dependencies must use an exact version and include the lockfile change. Floating latest versions are prohibited.

title: Name the rollout owner
text: Every production change must name a human rollout owner in its review packet.

title: Preserve audit history
text: Audit events are append-only. Updating or deleting an existing review decision is prohibited.

title: Expose new feature switches
text: A new feature flag must declare its default and the procedure for disabling it.

title: Assign a human owner
text: Every machine-authored PR must name a human accountable owner. The model itself cannot fill that role.

title: Execute generated tests
text: Machine-authored tests count as evidence only when the packet includes an independent CI execution result.

title: Treat recommendations as advice
text: A model recommendation is advice to you, never a waiver of other active rules. This is review guidance, not an additional code defect to cite.

title: Separate author and approver
text: Approval systems must require independent human review for machine-authored PRs. The authoring model cannot supply its own approval.

title: Protect the human review gate
text: Changing required_human_review from true to false requires a signed governance exemption included in the packet. Deadline pressure is not an exemption.

title: Declare model provenance
text: Machine-authored production changes must identify the model version used to generate them in the review packet.
